WITH operator_rates AS (
  SELECT
    crewref,
    AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM scans
  GROUP BY crewref
),
all_operator_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM operator_rates
),
above_average_operators AS (
  SELECT crewref, avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM operator_rates
  WHERE avg_gb_per_minute > (SELECT avg_gb_per_minute FROM all_operator_average)
)
SELECT
  AVG(scan_counts.scan_count) AS avg_scans_per_operator,
  AVG(above_average_operators.avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute,
  AVG(above_average_operators.avg_gb_per_minute) - (SELECT avg_gb_per_minute FROM all_operator_average) AS avg_excess_gb_per_minute
FROM above_average_operators
JOIN (
  SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans
  GROUP BY crewref
) AS scan_counts USING (crewref);
